'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**[[Militant]]s kill at least one [[Armed Forces of Burkina Faso|soldier]] and one civilian in the Karma [[gold mine]] in [[Yatenga Province]], [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gold-mine-attacked-burkina-faso-two-dead-mine-official-2022-06-09/ (Reuters)]
**Eleven gendarmes are killed during an attack by unidentified militants in [[Seytenga Department]], [[Séno Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/attackers-kill-11-military-police-burkina-faso-2022-06-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions]]
**The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] (DRC) claims that 500 disguised members of the [[Rwanda]]n [[special forces]] have intruded into the DRC. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-accuses-rwanda-sending-disguised-troops-across-border-2022-06-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Twenty-five people are killed in an attack by gunmen on motorcycles in [[Dikwa]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-islamist-insurgents-kill-25-nigerias-northeast-2022-06-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed and two injured after a minibus overturned in [[Miramor District]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://english.news.cn/20220610/0d1d7dbb8a3745d39d1bf692d1c24fb9/c.html (Xinhua)]
*A [[People's Liberation Army Air Force]] [[Chengdu J-7]] [[aircraft crash]]es in a residential area in [[Laohekou]], [[Hubei]], [[China]], killing at least one person on the ground as the pilot ejects out of the aircraft. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/06/09/china/pla-plane-crash-china-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*The bodies of two [[disability|disabled people]] are found in [[Roadford Lake]], near [[Okehampton]], [[Devon]], [[England]], a day after their boat capsized on the lake. Four others are in hospital, with one in critical condition. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-devon-61753302 (BBC News)]
*One person is killed and one other is injured after heavy flooding in [[Tirana]], [[Albania]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-storms-weather-business-fires-0b3bda8a67cdce2bd5409967d1506cfa (AP)]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]]
****[[Governor of Maryland|Governor]] [[Larry Hogan]] outlines a long-term preparedness plan on how [[Maryland]] will deal with [[COVID-19]] including a focus on treatments that would keep people out of hospitals as well as on how the state would respond to [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|future variants]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/maryland-governor-lays-out-long-term-plan-for-covid-19/2022/06/09/f06c756e-e82e-11ec-a422-11bbb91db30b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Spain]]
***[[Spain]] will begin [[vaccine|vaccinations]] of close contacts of [[monkeypox]] using the [[Smallpox vaccine#Imvanex|Imvanex vaccine]] after 242 cases were reported in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/spain-begin-monkeypox-vaccination-close-contacts-2022-06-09/ (Reuters)]
 
'''International relations'''
*[[2021–2022 Belarus–European Union border crisis]]
**[[Poland]] decides to lift its [[state of emergency]] over attempts by migrants to cross the [[Belarus–Poland border]], saying that the [[border barrier]] it has been building is mostly complete. [https://apnews.com/article/european-union-alexander-lukashenko-middle-east-poland-5ebc0a0dc92bcf39c877b190166286c3 (AP)]
*A 2-seater [[Beechcraft]] plane violates the airspace of seven countries in [[Eastern Europe]], and is intercepted by two [[Hungarian Air Force]] [[Saab JAS 39 Gripen|Gripen jets]], two [[United States Air Force|USAF]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]]s and two [[Romanian Air Force]] F-16s before being abandoned at an airfield near [[Targovishte]], [[Bulgaria]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/mystery-plane-puts-east-europe-air-forces-on-alert (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Daegu office fire]]
**Seven people are killed and 46 others are injured by a fire, suspected to be an [[arson]] attack, that spread through an [[office building]] in [[Daegu]], [[South Korea]]. The suspect is killed in the fire. [https://apnews.com/article/seoul-south-korea-business-fires-9d3fcdfd10da5688d61dc95d9c3f6ce4 (AP)]
*[[Cannabis in Thailand]]
**[[Thailand]] removes [[Cannabis (drug)|cannabis]] and [[hemp]] plants from its list of illegal [[narcotic]]s, and will allow people to grow an unlimited number of these plants in farms and gardens for [[medical cannabis|medicinal purposes]] as long as they inform the authorities. However, public consumption of these plants is discouraged by official authorities. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jun/08/thailand-to-ease-cannabis-rules-but-smokers-warned-over-smell-nuisance (''The Guardian'')]
**Three people are killed and another is injured in a mass shooting in [[Smithsburg]], [[Maryland]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pennsylvania-maryland-baltimore-shootings-fa930b3f1b8cd9ec38c8b6499e170d6e (AP)]
*The [[Donetsk People's Republic]] (DPR) sentences to death two [[Briton]]s and a [[Morocco|Moroccan]] who had [[International Legion of Territorial Defense of Ukraine|joined Ukrainian forces]] on charges of [[Terrorism in Ukraine|terrorism]], [[mercenary ]]activities, and attempting to overthrow the DPR's government. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-moscow-business-blockades-74883ed750fb8778259cf733e1095fb8 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[European Parliament]] adopts a resolution urging to amend the [[treaties of the European Union]] in order to abolish the unanimity principle in decisionmaking with respect to sanctions and foreign policy and to grant the Parliament the right to legislative initiative. [https://www.politico.eu/article/meps-adopt-proposal-for-treaty-changeeuropean-convention/ (Politico)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] announces that the [[James Webb Space Telescope]] collided with a [[micrometeoroid]] last month, but continues to function normally. [https://phys.org/news/2022-06-james-webb-telescope-micrometeoroid-nasa.html (Phys.org)]
